messages.subject: Weights in ubms colext model selection
parts:
Hi all,

I have been doing trying to do model selection for a set of dynamic occupancy models using ubms. I have found some documentation on comparing models by looking at elpd or elpd_diff/se_diff for ubms models (I am using the function modSel). However, the top-ranked models do not have more weight even though their elpd is higher and I struggling to understand or explain why.



Is anyone aware of any studies/references that I can use to justify explaining top ranked models using elpd? Or why the weights are not higher for higher ranked models? I have been trying to understand some more on the leave-one-out cross validation method for model selection, but I'm struggling to understand the stats.

Any help would be appreciated, thanks!

Vishnu

I'd just ignore the weights and focus on elpd_diff and se_diff. I've seen several examples of weird results for the weights when everything else makes sense. I should probably just remove them from the table.
If you are able to send me your fitList object off-list though (probably a big file, so maybe very difficult) I wouldn't mind taking a closer look at it to see if there is some bug.

Ken
